question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(4\operatorname{ln}⁡x+\operatorname{arcsch}⁡{x}^{4}) \\  & =4\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡x)+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡{x}^{4}) \\  & =\frac{4}{x}+(-\frac{1}{|{x}^{4}|\sqrt{1+({x}^{4})^{2}}})\cdot ({x}^{4})^{′} \\  & =\frac{4}{x}-\frac{1}{{x}^{4}\sqrt{1+{x}^{8}}}\cdot 4{x}^{3} \\  & =\frac{4}{x}-\frac{4}{x\sqrt{1+{x}^{8}}} \\  & =\frac{4}{x}(1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+{x}^{8}}}).\end{aligned}
$$
